summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Massimiliano Di Silvestre as Chief Marketing Commercial Officer effective July 1, 2026, succeeding Enrico Galliera, who departed after sixteen years. The change is a voluntary leadership succession, not a forced departure, reported via a press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed. The filing is a routine update for a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16. Watch for any future strategic shifts under the new marketing head, but this is not a special situation requiring risk-arb analysis.
